name: maintenance_work_request
description: REQ-893 (CMMS slice 1 part 1), docs/cmms/scope-draft.md. One report of a fault on one asset card. asset_card_id is the record id of an assets_card, a declarative reference checked in code through Letflow.Modules.ReadApi.lookup/3, never a foreign key (decision 0076). org_unit_id is the card's org unit copied at create (the scope column). description is 1 to 2000 characters and urgency is low, normal or urgent (UAT assumptions, to be confirmed by the process owner); both are checked by the writer of the request (REQ-894). status is new, ordered or rejected. reported_by is a user id. order_id names the work order made from the request. document_id is the issued maintenance_request document.
